summary: Icon Energy Corp. filed a Form 6-K with unaudited interim financials, a press release on a chartered containership investment, and a new Master Management Agreement with Pavimar Shipping Co. that expands corporate and ship management services. The agreement sets quarterly fees of $25,000/vessel plus $125,000 group fee, 1% capital raising commission, 1% annual investment administration fee on NAV, and 15% contingent fee on realized net profits from passive investments. It also includes vessel management fees and an eight-year renewable term with termination fee provisions. This is an ordinary business update and service contract, not a special situation.
